verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents its own background automation in one narrow form: recurring automatic payouts on a configurable schedule, and automatic splitting of payouts to sellers. There is no general-purpose or agentic automation builder in the evidence. Webhooks, the CLI and the MCP server are developer building blocks for constructing automations, not automations themselves, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable automation/workflow capability, agent-driven background tasks, triggers beyond payouts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

automatically pay out a portion to sellers or service providers on your marketplace
